latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of maker-youtube — your fast, cloud-based YouTube video editing tool.

- Upload raw video footage (up to 500MB). Supported: MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM.
- Automated editing (cut silences, add intro, etc.) via simple prompts.
- Cloud rendering delivers 1080p MP4 downloads, YouTube-ready within 1–2 minutes.
- Built-in API authentication and session management; free tier includes 100 credits.
- Direct text commands for exporting, credits check, status, and editing actions.
- Error handling and helpful user feedback for uploads, exports, and credits.
